integrity: Analytical proof supported by an independently implemented generalized-eigenvalue checker; finite computations do not certify all parameters.
scientific_limitations: Only the specified five-state reversible adsorption/desorption chain; does not cover continuum, nonuniform exterior desorption, more compartments or total-variation mixing. One historically relevant original article was not fully accessible; priority risk remains.
title: A sharp adsorption-allocation reversal and an exact iso-gap surface in a five-state diffusion chain
